sections.heading: Case
paragraphs: CSQ-712. Tenant Northmere Produce. Region EU. Site Cedar Dock 2. One gateway dropped off the network at 07:42 UTC on 26 October.

sections.heading: Progress
paragraphs: The site checked power and swapped the Ethernet cable. Other gateways at the site stayed online. Fleet Operations authorized a spare using OPS-008. The original unit is in the return kit with the case ID attached.

sections.heading: Next update
paragraphs: Customer Enablement will send a progress update after the first live reading. Preserve the old gateway assignment until Fleet Engineering confirms reset and closes the asset record.
